text: {"domain":"Crop Insurance","policy_name":"Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)","insurer":"Government of India (implemented through empanelled public and private insurance companies)","what_it_does":"Government-backed crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases, helping to stabilize farm income.","premium":{"kharif_crops":"2% of sum insured","rabi_crops":"1.5% of sum insured","annual_commercial_or_horticultural_crops":"5% of sum insured","note":"These are the maximum premium shares payable by farmers; the balance actuarial premium is subsidized by Central and State governments."},"government_subsidy":"Typically 90–98% of the actuarial premium is borne by the Central and State governments, depending on the crop and state.","coverage":["Yield loss due to widespread natural calamities such as drought, flood, cyclone, hailstorm, and other notified events","Loss due to pests and crop diseases for notified crops","Prevented sowing or planting in notified areas due to adverse weather conditions","Post-harvest losses for specified crops caused by unseasonal rain or cyclones for a limited period after harvest, as per scheme rules","Localised calamities such as hailstorm, landslide, and inundation affecting individual farms, where notified"],"exclusions":["Losses due to farmer negligence or improper farming practices","Losses to crops not notified under the scheme by the state","Post-harvest losses occurring beyond the notified coverage period","Non-compliance with scheme guidelines or false claims"],"notified_crops_and_area_basis":{"notified_crops":"Food crops (cereals, millets, pulses), oilseeds, annual commercial crops, and annual horticultural crops as notified by the respective state government.","area_approach":"Implemented on an 'area approach' basis where yield loss is assessed for a defined notified unit area, and all insured farmers in that unit receive compensation based on the same threshold yield."},"claim_and_payout_notes":{"sum_insured_basis":"Sum insured is generally linked to the scale of finance, loan amount, or cost of cultivation for the insured crop.","payout_trigger":"Claims are paid if the actual yield in the notified area falls below the threshold yield fixed for that crop and area.","timeline_goal":"The scheme aims to settle claims within approximately 2 months after final yield data is received, although timelines may vary by state."},"best_for":["Loanee farmers who take crop loans from banks or cooperative societies","Non-loanee farmers who cultivate notified crops in participating districts","Farmers seeking protection from weather, pest, and yield risks at a very low premium cost"],"enrolment_and_access":{"how_farmers_enrol":["Automatically through banks or cooperative societies when availing crop loans","Through Common Service Centres (CSC) or the PMFBY online portal in many states","Through authorised insurance company agents or agriculture department offices"],"required_details":["Land ownership or cultivation records","Crop type, season, and cultivated area details","Active bank account details for direct claim credit","KYC documents as per state and insurer requirements"]},"state_variation_note":"Coverage details, notified crops, premium subsidy sharing, and claim timelines vary by state and season.","scheme_governance":{"implemented_by":"Government of India in coordination with State Governments and empanelled insurance companies.","key_objectives":["Provide affordable and comprehensive crop insurance coverage against natural and biological risks","Stabilize farmers’ income and reduce dependence on ad-hoc disaster relief","Encourage adoption of modern agricultural practices","Improve credit flow to the agriculture sector"]}}

{"domain":"Health Insurance","policy_name":"Star Health Comprehensive Plan","what_it_does":"Broad health insurance for individuals and families with extensive coverage and no room-rent cap in many variants.","coverage_highlights":["No room rent cap (you can choose any room category as per policy terms)","In-patient hospitalization expenses","Pre-hospitalization expenses (typically up to 60 days)","Post-hospitalization expenses (typically up to 90 days)","Maternity and newborn baby coverage after applicable waiting period","Coverage for many modern treatments and procedures","Bariatric (weight-loss) surgery as per policy conditions","Second medical opinion facility","100% restoration of the sum insured once in a policy year after exhaustion"],"key_conditions":["Waiting periods apply for pre-existing diseases (multi-year in many cases)","Waiting period for maternity and newborn benefits","Specific waiting periods for listed illnesses and procedures","Sub-limits and co-pays may apply depending on the chosen variant and age","General exclusions like cosmetic surgery, non-medical expenses, etc."],"insurer":"Star Health and Allied Insurance","insurer_metrics_notes":{"network_hospitals":"14,000+ network hospitals offering cashless treatment (approximate reported figure).","claim_settlement_ratio_trend":"Health claim settlement ratio roughly in the 80–90% band in recent years (indicative range).","regulatory_notes":"Standalone health insurer with strong cashless approvals; some periods of regulatory scrutiny on claim practices have been reported."},"best_for":["Individuals and families who want flexibility in choosing hospital room (no room-rent cap in many variants)","Customers who prioritize a strong cashless network and are comfortable reading detailed terms and exclusions"]}

{"domain":"Health Insurance","policy_name":"Star Health Family Health Optima","plan_type":"Family floater","what_it_does":"Provides a single shared sum insured for the entire family under one health policy.","coverage_highlights":["In-patient hospitalization for all covered family members","Daycare procedures that do not require 24-hour hospitalization","Organ donor expenses as per policy terms","Automatic restoration of sum insured after it is exhausted (subject to conditions)","Worldwide emergency coverage in many variants (emergency treatments outside India)","Maternity and newborn coverage options after applicable waiting periods","Cashless hospitalization at Star Health’s extensive network hospitals"],"key_conditions":["Waiting periods for pre-existing diseases, maternity and specified illnesses apply","Certain sub-limits, co-pays or disease-wise limits may exist depending on variant and age","Maximum age and relationship rules for who can be included in the floater"],"insurer":"Star Health and Allied Insurance","best_for":["3–5 member families who prefer a single floater policy instead of multiple individual covers","Families looking for restoration benefits and optional worldwide emergency coverage"]}

{"domain":"Health Insurance","policy_name":"Niva Bupa Health Companion Plan","what_it_does":"Comprehensive health insurance for individuals and families with strong restoration and wellness/check-up features.","coverage_highlights":["In-patient care for hospitalization above 24 hours","Daycare treatments that require less than 24 hours of hospitalization","Coverage for AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) and modern treatments","Organ donor expenses as per policy terms","Pre-hospitalization expenses for a defined number of days","Post-hospitalization expenses for a defined number of days","Unlimited sum insured restoration in many variants when sum insured is exhausted","Annual health check-ups for insured members (subject to terms)","Cashless hospitalization at Niva Bupa’s network hospitals"],"optional_riders":["Daily hospital cash benefit","Claim protection / claim safeguard rider (covers non-payable items or protects NCB, depending on design)"],"family_coverage":"Can cover up to 19 family members in certain family floater structures, making it suitable for large/joint families.","insurer":"Niva Bupa Health Insurance","insurer_metrics_notes":{"claim_settlement_ratio_trend":"CSR and ICR generally in a competitive band for standalone health insurers (exact numbers vary by year and product).","positioning":"Strong focus on urban, digitally savvy customers with emphasis on cashless, wellness and check-up benefits."},"best_for":["Tech-savvy individuals and families who value unlimited restoration and wellness features like annual check-ups","Large or joint families needing coverage for many members under one umbrella"]}

{"domain":"Health / Accident / Travel","policy_name":"Star Health Insurance (General Overview)","positioning":"Large standalone health insurer offering multiple products across health, personal accident and travel segments.","key_features":["Network of 14,000+ hospitals providing cashless treatment, especially strong in many urban and semi-urban areas","24/7 customer support and digital claim intimation/monitoring","Coverage for pre-existing diseases after completion of specified waiting periods","Maternity and newborn coverage in eligible plans after waiting periods","Multiple riders/add-ons such as personal accident, critical illness, top-up and super top-up options"],"key_metrics":{"claim_settlement_ratio_trend":"CSR approximately in the 80–88% range in recent years (varies by year and source).","incurred_claim_ratio_trend":"ICR generally within the typical health insurance band, reflecting high claim volumes.","notes":"One of the largest retail health insurers in India by number of policies and claims handled."}}

{"domain":"Home Insurance","policy_name":"ICICI Lombard Complete Home Protect","what_it_does":"Covers the structure and/or contents of a home against major natural and man-made risks.","coverage":["Fire, lightning, explosion and implosion","Flood, inundation, storm, cyclone and other natural calamities","Earthquake damage to structure and contents","Burglary, housebreaking and attempted theft","Damage to household contents such as furniture, appliances and electronics","Optional cover for jewellery and valuables via add-ons (up to specified limits)"],"premium_example":"₹18/month for ₹5 lakh sum insured for a pucca building (illustrative only, not an actual quote).","premium_depends_on":["Total sum insured (structure + contents)","Type of dwelling (pucca / kachcha, flat / independent house)","Location risk (flood/quake zone, crime rate, etc.)","Security features (locks, alarms, gated community, etc.)","Policy term (1 year to multi-year options)","Optional covers selected (jewellery, terrorism, etc.)"],"structure_and_contents_details":{"structure_cover":"Protects the building structure (walls, roof, floors, built-in fittings) usually on reinstatement value basis, for homes up to a certain age (e.g., 50 years).","contents_cover":"Protects household contents (furniture, appliances, electronics, personal belongings) usually on market value basis after depreciation.","who_can_buy":["Homeowners for structure + contents","Tenants for contents-only cover"]},"insurer":"ICICI Lombard General Insurance","insurer_metrics_notes":{"claim_settlement_ratio_trend":"Health/general CSR typically in a competitive band (approx. mid-80s to 90s depending on product/year).","notes":"Large private general insurer with strong digital purchase and claim support."},"best_for":["Homeowners wanting low-cost protection for both structure and contents","Tenants wanting contents-only cover for appliances, furniture and valuables"]}

{"domain":"Home Insurance","policy_name":"HDFC ERGO Home Shield","what_it_does":"Protects the residential building and its contents against major natural and man-made risks, with useful living-expense add-ons.","coverage":["Loss or damage to building and contents due to fire, lightning and explosion","Damage due to flood, storm, cyclone and other specified natural disasters","Earthquake cover for structure and contents (if opted)","Burglary, theft and housebreaking losses to contents","Electrical and mechanical breakdown cover for specified appliances (if selected)","Coverage for reconstruction/repair of building and replacement of contents after covered events","Rent for alternative accommodation if the insured house becomes uninhabitable (as per chosen limit)"],"additional_features":["Option to cover jewellery on worldwide basis (up to defined limits)","Option to cover portable equipment like mobiles, laptops and cameras on all-risk basis","New-for-old replacement for contents up to a certain age (typically 10 years) in many variants","Auto restoration of loss limit for contents after a claim in some options","Optional covers like hotel stay, brokerage and shifting expenses when moving to alternate accommodation","Discounts based on security and long-term coverage options"],"who_can_buy":["Homeowners for structure-only, contents-only, or combined structure + contents","Tenants for contents-only cover"],"insurer":"HDFC ERGO General Insurance","insurer_metrics_notes":{"claim_settlement_ratio_trend":"Overall claim settlement ratios for general/health business generally in the 90%+ band in recent disclosures (exact numbers vary by segment and year).","notes":"Known for digital-first processes and wide partner network; home product positioned as long-term, discounted cover."},"best_for":["Flat or house owners concerned about natural disasters and burglary","Customers who want structure + contents cover plus temporary accommodation benefits"]}

{"domain":"Life Insurance","policy_name":"LIC Jeevan Umang","plan_type":"Whole life with income (participating, non-linked)","what_it_does":"Combines lifelong life cover with guaranteed yearly income after the premium paying term and a maturity benefit at age 100.","benefits":{"survival_benefit":"Guaranteed annual survival benefit of 8% of the Basic Sum Assured every year after the premium paying term, payable till age 100 or death, whichever is earlier.[web:155][web:156][web:163]","maturity_benefit":"At age 100, if the life assured survives, a lump sum equal to Sum Assured + vested simple reversionary bonus + final additional bonus (if any) is paid.[web:156][web:158][web:161][web:163]","death_benefit":"If death occurs during the policy term (any time up to age 100), the nominee receives a lump sum death benefit (typically Sum Assured on Death + bonuses as per policy rules). Life cover is active from day one.[web:154][web:161][web:163]","loan_facility":"Policy loans allowed after acquiring surrender value, giving liquidity while continuing cover.[web:161][web:163]"},"nature":"Savings + protection plan (not a pure term plan) – premium per ₹1 lakh cover is higher compared to pure term insurance but provides income plus maturity value.[web:155][web:158][web:161]","key_parameters":{"coverage_upto_age":"Coverage and benefits available up to 100 years of age of the life assured.[web:155][web:158][web:163]","premium_paying_terms":"Common PPT options include 15, 20, 25 and 30 years; policy term is effectively 100 − entry age.[web:163]","entry_age":"Minimum and maximum entry age are defined by LIC (check latest brochure/UIN for exact numbers).[web:154][web:161]"},"insurer":"Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)","insurer_metrics_notes":{"claim_settlement_ratio_trend":"LIC’s overall life claim settlement ratio has been around 98–99% over recent years (e.g., ~98.15% in FY 2024–25).[web:159][web:164][web:167]","notes":"LIC handles the highest volume of life claims in India and is widely seen as one of the most reliable life insurers."},"best_for":["People who want guaranteed long-term yearly income plus life cover up to 100 years","Conservative investors who value guarantees and LIC’s high claim settlement record over maximum-return or low-premium term-only solutions"]}

{"domain":"Education / Child Plan","policy_name":"BrightFuture EduPlan","what_it_does":"Helps build a dedicated corpus for children’s higher education while ensuring that funding continues even if the parent (life assured) dies.","features":{"savings_component":"Part of each premium goes towards building an education corpus that can be used for future school, college, or higher education costs.","life_cover_on_parent":"Provides life insurance on the parent; on the parent’s death, the insurer may pay an immediate lump sum and/or continue future premiums (premium waiver) so that the child’s benefits are not disrupted.[web:160][web:162][web:165][web:168]","loan_protection":"Can be structured to cover or support repayment of education loans in case the parent is no longer around.","flexible_payout_structure":["Lump sum at key milestones such as start of higher secondary, undergraduate, or postgraduate education","Periodic payouts to meet tuition fees and living expenses across multiple years rather than only one big payout[web:160][web:162][web:165][web:168]"]},"plan_nature":"Investment-cum-insurance child education plan; may be endowment-style (guaranteed) or market-linked (ULIP-type), depending on product design.[web:162][web:165][web:168]","key_customisation_options":["Choice of policy term to align with child’s age and target education years","Choice of premium payment mode (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly or single)[web:162][web:165]","Choice of payout pattern: lump sum at maturity, staggered payouts at milestones, or a combination[web:160][web:162][web:165][web:168]"],"best_for":["Parents who want structured and disciplined savings for a child’s education plus protection if something happens to them","Families who prefer fixed, pre-planned payouts at school/UG/PG stages instead of ad-hoc investing"]}
